name: Amazon Route 53
description: Sends DNS zones to public hosted zones in Amazon Route 53. The panel keeps the records, and the plugin makes the hosted zone the same after each change.

credentials.label: Access key ID
credentials.hint: The access key of an IAM user with the Route 53 permissions in the README of the plugin.

credentials.label: KMS key ARN for DNSSEC
credentials.hint: Only for DNSSEC: an asymmetric KMS key in us-east-1 with the key spec ECC_NIST_P256 and the key usage Sign and verify.
